instructions: Read-only tools over AI-Portal data (https://www.ai-portal.ai): AI model releases, AI regulations, a GenAI glossary, and daily curated GenAI news. Use list_releases for "when did model X ship / what did provider Y release", list_regulations for AI compliance status, search_glossary for term definitions, and get_latest_news for current GenAI headlines.
